- [EVENT] User is looking to get tips on how to properly clean their bike.
- [PREFERENCE] User has been using a specialized bike cleaner.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Proper cleaning is essential to maintain bike performance, prevent corrosion, and extend lifespan.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cleaning supplies recommended: soft-bristled brush, clean soft cloth, bike cleaner, degreaser (optional), water, clean dry cloth.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended cleaning steps: remove loose dirt, apply bike cleaner, let it sit, wipe down frame and components, clean wheels and tires, degrease chain and gears (if necessary), rinse bike (optional), dry bike.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips: avoid high-pressure hoses, don't use harsh chemicals, clean bike regularly, lubricate chain after cleaning.
